definition.description: Conceptual vocabulary for electromagnetism. Apply only the declared objects, relations, quantities, and laws when their assumptions fit the user's confirmed description.

objectTypes.description: Particle with charge and possible motion.

objectTypes.label: vùng trường
objectTypes.description: Region with specified electric or magnetic field.

objectTypes.label: dây dẫn
objectTypes.description: Conductor subject to field or induction.

relationTypes.description: Object located in a declared field region.

relationTypes.label: trường do nguồn
relationTypes.description: Field produced by a charge source.

quantityDefinitions.description: Electric field component or magnitude with direction.

laws.name: Lực điện trường
assumptions: Field at particle location is known.

laws.name: Lực từ
assumptions: Relative direction or angle is known.
Field geometry and direction must be specified or inferred from the described arrangement.

laws.name: Định luật Faraday
assumptions: Flux over time or its derivative is known.

applicationRequirements.description: Clarify field direction and geometry when they affect the requested result.
Field evolution requires a spatial electromagnetic model.
Field strength or source law must be supported by supplied facts and applicable laws.

simulationCapability.scope: LLM-generated contextual SVG/PixiJS presentation. Physical quantities are computed from applicable approved capability equation ASTs. Participant names, counts, shapes and environments are unrestricted by the renderer.
limitations: Verified computation requires all relevant behavior to map to declared executable capabilities and their validity domains. Unmapped behavior is explicitly visual-only and unverified.
Verified computation requires all relevant behavior to map to declared executable capabilities and their validity domains. Unmapped behavior is explicitly visual-only and unverified.

conceptVocabulary.guidance: Listed concepts guide interpretation but are not an exhaustive allowlist. An unlisted concept may be introduced only when grounded in the user's confirmed description and an established high-school physics law; explain the law and any assumptions. If that grounding is uncertain, clarify instead of inventing behavior.

visualCapability.scope: Generate or draw procedural visual elements from the confirmed setup, its objects, relations, and quantities. Never require a fixed asset catalog entry for an object.
visualCapability.purpose: An explanatory visual illustrates the phenomenon and declared assumptions. It is not evidence of a numerical physical simulation.
visualCapability.interaction: Changing parameter controls recomputes backend solver fields; PixiJS updates the generated SVG layers from those fields. Decorative presentation controls remain separate from physics.

assumptions: Điện trường đều hướng theo trục y (E > 0 hướng lên); hạt bay vào song song trục x; bỏ qua trọng lực.
Từ trường đều vuông góc mặt phẳng hình (B > 0 hướng ra ngoài mặt hình); hạt bay vào vuông góc với B từ gốc O theo trục x; bỏ qua trọng lực.
Điện tích Q đứng yên tại gốc O; điện tích q chuyển động trên trục Ox (x > 0) chỉ dưới tác dụng lực Coulomb; q không đi tới gốc O.
Khung dây phẳng quay đều trong từ trường đều quanh trục vuông góc với B.
Máy biến áp lí tưởng, không hao phí; điện áp sơ cấp xoay chiều hình sin.
